title: Where is Sine Positive?
text:
Using the CAST rule:
- Quadrant 1: All positive (A)
- Quadrant 2: Sine positive (S)
- Quadrant 3: Tangent positive (T)
- Quadrant 4: Cosine positive (C)

Sine is positive in Q1 and Q2.

title: General Solution Formula for Sine
text:
For sin x = sin alpha (where alpha is the reference angle):

Quadrant 1: x = alpha + 360°n
Quadrant 2: x = (180° - alpha) + 360°n

With alpha = 30°:
- Q1: x = 30° + 360°n
- Q2: x = 150° + 360°n

title: Complete General Solution
text: $$x = 30° + 360°n$$ or $$x = 150° + 360°n$$, where n is any integer.
